name: GetResponse
label: GetResponse API 3.0 — contacts, lists, newsletters
description: Official GetResponse API 3.0 at https://api.getresponse.com/v3. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Auth: X-Auth-Token: api-key <apiKey> (retail). In GetResponse a campaign is a list. Contacts are PII; newsletters are marketing messages — operator holds CAN-SPAM/CASL/GDPR consent. Customer owns the GetResponse account. Unused API keys expire after 90 days. apiKey is never logged or returned. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger.listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. campaign is { campaignId } (list token, not the 8-digit UI number). Do not put apiKey here. Example: {"operation":"contact.get","contactId":"…"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: 'contact.create' | 'contact.get' | 'contact.list' | 'contact.update' | 'contact.delete' | 'campaign.list' | 'newsletter.send' | 'tag.add' | 'trigger.listen'. trigger.listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: email
schema.description: Contact email for contact.create. PII. Operator must have consent.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Display name (contact) or internal newsletter name.

schema.label: content
schema.description: newsletter.send content {html, plain}. Official GetResponse content (not a generic blob).

schema.label: fromField
schema.description: Sender for newsletter.send (required): {fromFieldId} from GET /from-fields. Example: {"fromFieldId":"V"}.

schema.label: tags
schema.description: Tag ids for contact.create/update or tag.add.

schema.label: sendOn
schema.description: ISO 8601 datetime to schedule newsletter.send, sent as sendSettings.sendOn. Omit to send immediately. Example: 2026-12-01T09:00:00+0000.

schema.label: sendSettings
schema.description: Audience for newsletter.send (required by GetResponse): selectedCampaigns, selectedSegments, selectedContacts, selectedSuppressions, excludedCampaigns, excludedSegments, timeTravel, perfectTiming. sendOn is merged in. Example: {"selectedCampaigns":["V"],"timeTravel":"false","perfectTiming":"false"}.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data. contact.create often returns 202 queued. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: contact.create | contact.get | contact.list | contact.update | contact.delete | campaign.list | newsletter.send | tag.add | trigger.listen. Selecting trigger.listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: GetResponse API key (StudioQuack secret). Sent as X-Auth-Token: api-key <key>. Unused keys expire after 90 days. Never log or place on INPUT. OAuth Bearer is an alternate official mode; this node uses api-key (one auth type).

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
